title: Ops findings resource payload
description: Read-only, admin-gated projection of the deterministic ops findings at honua://ops/findings. Mirrors the honua-server OpsFindingsListResponse (GET /api/v1/admin/observability/findings): the evaluation time plus the active findings ordered by descending severity. Each finding carries a kebab-case rule, severity, plain-language explanation, subject identifiers, evidence references, and a recommendedAction {kind, summary, reason} (null for informational findings) that the console proposes by finding id — the opaque execution payload is never surfaced and is never autonomously executed (honua-server ADR-0028 posture). Read-only — no control paths. Same gated pattern as the promotion-surface resources. x-honua-reference-shape: this shape tracks the reference implementation.

generatedAt.description: UTC time the findings were evaluated.

findings.description: Active findings, ordered by descending severity.

id.description: Deterministic finding identifier (used to propose its action).

subject.description: Subject identifiers a finding pins to (all optional).

recommendedAction.description: Recommended action, or absent/null when the finding is informational. Proposed by finding id through the operation gateway; never autonomously executed.

kind.description: OperationClass the action routes through: AdminConfigChange / Deploy / MetadataRelease / Seed.

reason.description: Operator-facing reason recorded on the proposal.
